rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof shingles is clearly property damage to their own structure.
claim_summary: Four roof shingles blown off back porch overhang by wind last weekend; no interior water damage. Estimated repair cost: $400. Policy has $2,500 deductible, which exceeds the estimated damage.

case_facts.description: approximately four shingles blown off by wind; no interior water damage
